name: PhotoGIMP
description:
PhotoGIMP is a customized configuration patch for the GIMP image editor designed specifically for users transitioning from Adobe Photoshop. It reorganizes the interface, tool shortcuts, and panel layouts to match Photoshop workflows.

Features:
- Familiar Photoshop-style workspace layout with reorganized toolboxes and docks
- Hundreds of Photoshop-matching keyboard shortcuts for common editing operations
- Pre-installed curated collection of third-party plugins, Python filters, and brushes
- Modern dark theme typography and clean iconography
- Retains all underlying non-destructive editing and photo manipulation capabilities of GIMP
